notes.title: Wishlist Card Crawl Adventure Now
notes.notes:
Hey,

the coming soon page for Card Crawl Adventure is now live.
Make sure to wishlist the game now!

👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190260/Card_Crawl_Adventure/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190260/Card_Crawl_Adventure/[/url]

If you enjoyed Card Crawl but also wanted a bigger and deeper gameplay experience,
Card Crawl Adventure is for you.

Card Crawl Adventure is a single player card game with light deck building and roguelite elements. Engage in a unique path based combat mechanic to battle against devious tavern bosses. Visit a variety of cozy taverns, collect cards and improve your deck with magic equipment items and charms.

We also released a new Wishlist Now Trailer in which I explain the basics of the game and show of some of the games gameplay and content:

[previewyoutube=Q7MwkEY0VmM;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!
🍻

notes.title: Challenge Modifiers
notes.notes:
Hey,

this is a small update for the Challenge mode.
I've included a modifier mechanic, where each Challenge game
now has slightly altered cards or starting values to make each Challenge
more unique.

Cheers

notes.title: Long overdue Card Crawl update, including new game mode and localizations.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

this is a long overdue Card Crawl updated for Win and Mac.

I've updated a few internals and fixed a few bugs.
This includes the Daily game which was broken after some server backend issues.

I've added localizations for
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Russian
[*] Japanese
[*] Chinese Simplified
[/list]

There's also a new game mode, which will replace the Deck Merchant custom decks,
which where deprecated on the Desktop version for quite some time.

Challenge mode will pit you agains 10 other friendly foes and allows you to
play in 1-month seasons to climb to first rank.
If this game mode is well received I consider updating this with more game modifiers
to spice up the base gameplay a bit.

Thanks for playing and if you haven't yet leave us a review.

Best
Arnold
🍻

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello Crawler,

this is another small bugfix update.
Thanks for your feedback! If you haven't please leave us a quick review, this helps a lot.

What's New?
+ Fixed: Total gold is not visible in the result screen
+ Fixed: Weird card movement when unlocking a card and then moving the list
+ Fixed: Pause button invisible after a restart

Happy Crawling!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31342250/8bf1323fb5d679fe5617b6bae5f020ba97e61337.png[/img]
